description.value: The Consulate UWS is a French brasserie at 519 Columbus Avenue New York, NY 10024. It sits on the corner of Columbus Avenue and West 85th Street near Central Park. The restaurant lists Happy Hour Monday – Friday: 3:30 – 6:30 PM, and brunch on weekends.
